text: The restricted RTT ghost vacuum has exchange, graded vacuum cohomology and monoidal Koszul cochains on bounded-below finite-type lattices. The source also gives all-rank, all-level divided-state fields, while adopted algebraic and formal point dualities have their own completion conventions. Full smooth quantum duality and the comparison of fixed-level collision with the level-additive coproduct remain separate.

For the general-linear Yang double of rank n≥2 at each finite quantum precision, point duality holds between termwise R_N-free complexes of smooth modules, with R_N=C[hbar]/(hbar^N), N≥1, and graded-projective curved contramodules, using reduction-defined null classes. Support estimates, finite base change, adjunction and unit/counit are retained, including critical level. The formal limit, ordinary-derived equivalence and factorization-module comparison are stronger statements and remain separate.
The scalar H3 formula retains its classical configuration-space input. H4 also retains the separately checked but unadopted fixed-arity input; neither is discharged by two modular rank computations.
The contact-aware additive derived-coend formula on A¹ and G_m, with every incoming simplex and split positive vacuum.

For finite sums of integrable simples at positive integral affine level, the derived product is the Verlinde multiplicity sum tensored with H_b(ΩG;C). Multiplication into the simple-VOA output kills positive loop-factor degree and is an isomorphism only on the loop-degree-zero multiplicities, including for a simple-vacuum input.

Strong orientation has its adopted rank-two scope. The compact source has all-length spherical classical coefficient arrows and local mixed flags; the stronger global derived/mixed comparison and primitive recognition retain moments, gerbes, parity and common translation data.
